dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kaeya, you're fond of a good drink, aren't you? Weinlesefest must be right up your alley.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm sorry, my mind was elsewhere... What was your question?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, never mind. Nothing that important.
